summary: Greenidge Generation Holdings Inc. entered into exchange agreements on May 29 and June 1, 2026, issuing 1,162,221 shares of Class A common stock in exchange for $2,089,400 aggregate principal amount of its 8.50% Senior Notes due October 2026. The exchanges were conducted under Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act, allowing issuances to existing holders without registration or commission. The company may pursue similar transactions for the remaining $33,138,350 outstanding principal. This debt-for-equity swap reduces near-term cash interest obligations and overhang. Watch for potential dilution impact and subsequent exchange announcements.
